# Field Operations Handbook — Large Markdown Fixture

This fictional engineering handbook contains 100 distinct station reports, not copies of the small sample. Its measurements are deterministic synthetic data, not scientific observations. The paired image edition adds one distinct raster per report. PNG charts and diagrams mix with baseline/progressive and color/grayscale JPEG spatial surveys. Dimensions and compressed sizes vary. All assets are local, so loading requires no network.

The text is approximately 100 times SAMPLE.md. The regular sample remains the compact syntax-coverage document. Use `python3 tools/scripts/generate-samples.py` to reproduce this handbook and its synthetic image assets.
